text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Oversized light gray off-shoulder sweatshirt with olive camouflage raglan sleeves and olive neckline binding, dark indigo very wide balloon jeans, tan suede high-top wedge sneakers with three hook-loop straps.。配饰：棕米格纹平檐帽，简洁白色装饰徽章。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Edit this exact complete wardrobe board. Remove the floating white letter badge below the cap, and attach that small white badge to the front of the plaid cap. The only accessory is the cap; no loose badge. Keep all remaining objects, garment designs, colors, fabrics and positions unchanged. Pure white background, no people, body parts, mannequins or text. Do not add anything.
